'''Troll brutes''' are low level trolls in the [[Burthorpe Troll Cave]]. They were first introduced during the [[Burthorpe]] tutorial and afterwards can be fought along with [[troll shaman]]s and [[troll chucker]]s. They appear to be, along with the troll chuckers and troll shamans, some of the only [[gold charm]] droppers for [[free-to-play]] players. They can be found in the western section of the Burthorpe Troll Cave, north of Burthorpe.

** Troll chuckers, shamans and brutes in the Burthorpe troll cave now all give golden rocks.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (16 September 2019)|date=16 September 2019}}
